mentions.name: Refrigerator ice maker repair
mentions.description: A hands-on repair of the refrigerator's ice maker, using AI to help diagnose the appliance; it is the third time performing this repair.
mentions.problem: The ice maker in the refrigerator is broken and needs repair.
mentions.source_excerpt: Repairing the ice maker in the frig.  This will be my third time in.  Of all the uses of Ai, diagnosing appliances is easily the most amazing to me.
mentions.author: ynac
